description: Sizes up a trade-in from written offers (CarMax, Carvana, dealers) and what's still owed: the best offer still open, which is the floor a dealer's trade number is compared with, the equity or negative equity, and, with a state and vehicle price, the sales tax the trade saves where the state credits it. Use it before visiting dealers; check_quote compares a quote's trade allowance with these offers.

city.description: City or county in the state's rate table (23 states; state_rules says which), like Pittsburgh or Allegheny County: sets the combined rate from the state's own rate file. Where a city is in several counties (Chicago, Milwaukee), give county too. A place name only, never an address or ZIP

county.description: County from the state's list (Pennsylvania, Nevada, Wisconsin; state_rules lists them), like Allegheny County: sets the combined rate. A county name only, never an address or ZIP

doc_fee.description: Doc fee; leave out to assume the state's cap, or a typical $450 where there is none

offers.description: Written trade-in offers, each with who made it, the amount and its last day

source.description: Who made the offer: CarMax, Carvana, a dealer. Never a person.

payoff.description: What is still owed on the car being traded

state.description: Two-letter state code, for the tax the trade saves

tax_rate.description: Combined sales tax rate as a decimal, local tax included (0.07 for 7%); leave out to use the state's rate

vehicle_price.description: The price of the car being bought, for the tax the trade saves

name: trade_in_position
title: Trade-in position
